kolobok.stove.missing_bricks: Not enough bricks: 11 around the furnace in two layers, and one more on top over the back right corner, the future chimney.
kolobok.stove.furnace_burning: The furnace is still burning. Let it burn out.
kolobok.stove.too_hot: The stove is roaring hot: expect a burnt crust!
kolobok.stove.no_logs: The stove is cold: put logs in the wood store underneath and light the oven with flint and steel.
kolobok.stove.not_lit: The stove is cold: light the oven with flint and steel.
kolobok.stove.nothing_to_light: Nothing to light: put logs in the wood store underneath.
kolobok.stove.other_logs: There is %s under there already. One kind of log at a time.
kolobok.stove.not_food: That doesn't cook in a stove.
kolobok.stove.oven_full: The oven won't take any more.
kolobok.stove.kolobok_inside: A Kolobok is sitting in the oven. Call him out first.
kolobok.stove.hot_enough: The stove is hot enough already.
kolobok.song.herobrine: I even ran away from Herobrine,
kolobok.song.end: And I'll run away from you!
kolobok.verse.learned: %s ran away from %s: a new verse for the song!
kolobok.verse.learned_unknown: %s even ran away from "%s": a new verse for the song!
kolobok.perk.zombie.desc: +2 armor. Ask anyone who bit him.
kolobok.perk.skeleton.desc: Every other arrow bounces off the crust.
kolobok.perk.enderman.desc: Left more than 24 blocks behind, he turns up next to his owner.
kolobok.perk.witch.desc: Witches' potions don't work on him.
kolobok.perk.phantom.desc: Tells his owner when they haven't slept for three nights.
kolobok.perk.blaze.desc: Fire and lava don't burn him.
kolobok.perk.warden.desc: Doesn't set off sculk or the Warden.
kolobok.perk.wither.desc: Withering has no hold on him.
kolobok.perk.ender_dragon.desc: A golden crust and eternal glory.
kolobok.perk.fox.desc: Foxes don't hunt him any more.
kolobok.songbook.legend: Legend: ran away from the dragon itself!
kolobok.songbook.no_perks: Hasn't run away from anyone yet. Give it time!
kolobok.songbook.empty: The songbook is empty. Show it to your Kolobok.
kolobok.say.idle.0.2: Bored... Maybe I'll run away from someone.
kolobok.say.idle.0.3: Swept from the barn, scraped from the bin. Great résumé, if you ask me.
kolobok.say.idle.1.0: Run, run, as fast as you can... Wrong tale. Different bread.
kolobok.say.idle.1.1: My cousin is a gingerbread man. We don't talk about him.
kolobok.say.idle.2.0: Who are you calling a breadwinner? I AM the bread.
kolobok.say.idle.2.2: It's not a bug, it's a crust.
kolobok.say.idle.3.0: Roll, sing, escape, repeat. Sigma grindset.
kolobok.say.idle.3.1: POV: you're a bun and everyone is hungry.
kolobok.say.night.0.0: Good night. I'll keep watch. (I won't.)
kolobok.say.night.0.1: The moon is my mom. Folklorists said so.
kolobok.say.night.2.0: Low battery. Going into toast mode.
kolobok.say.food_wheat.0.0: Wheat?! That's family! You're offering me my own relatives?
kolobok.say.food_bread.0.0: Is that... cousin Baguette? I can't eat family!
kolobok.say.food_pumpkin_pie.0.0: Pie?! We came out of the same oven!
kolobok.say.food_pumpkin_pie.2.0: Pumpkin pie... Uncle, we thought you got eaten back in 2011.
kolobok.say.turtle.0.0: That's not a helmet, that's someone's house.
kolobok.say.milk.0.0: Sour cream! Mixed with it, healed with it.
kolobok.say.milk.0.1: Ah, fresh! Hear that crust crunch?
kolobok.say.milk_untamed.0.0: Tasty! I'll think about it. From a safe distance.
kolobok.say.milk_untamed.0.1: Thanks for the snack. Still rolling away, though.
kolobok.say.tamed.0.0: Fine. From you, I won't run away!
kolobok.say.tamed.0.1: Deal: you're the oven, I'm the bun.
kolobok.say.full.0.0: I'm fresh enough! Save the sour cream.
kolobok.say.stale.0.0: Hmm, I'm going stale... A bit of sour cream would help.
kolobok.say.stale.0.1: My crust's turned to rusk. Where's my sour cream?
kolobok.say.sit.0.1: Staying put, like dough in a bowl.
kolobok.say.shoulder.0.0: Whoa, the view from up here!
kolobok.say.shoulder.2.0: Eyes in the back of your head: online.
kolobok.say.head.0.0: They say bread is the staff of life. Today I'm the hat of life.
kolobok.say.head.0.1: A warm hat that talks. You're welcome.
kolobok.say.dismount.0.0: Coming down. Careful, I'm fragile... Kidding, I'm brioche.
kolobok.say.hot.0.0: Ouch, hot! Hands off the fresh bake!
kolobok.say.hot.0.1: Careful, I'm fresh out of the oven!
kolobok.say.cooled.0.0: What are you all staring at?
kolobok.say.cooled.0.1: Cooled down. Well, time to roll!
kolobok.say.listened.0.1: You listen well. Almost like a fox... Suspicious.
kolobok.say.listened.2.0: Thanks for listening! Like and subscribe to the bun.
kolobok.say.unheard.0.0: Not so fast! Listen to my song first.
kolobok.say.unheard.0.1: Sour cream won't buy me. Hear the song out, then we'll talk.
kolobok.say.unheard.2.0: Listen to the track before you comment.
kolobok.say.mode_follow.0.0: Following you like a tiny round shadow.
kolobok.say.mode_crumbs.0.0: I'll leave crumbs so you don't get lost.
kolobok.say.mode_guard.0.0: On guard. Not a step back! Well, maybe a small one.
kolobok.say.mode_wander.0.0: Going for a stroll. Not far. Probably.
kolobok.say.to_stove.0.0: I'm a bit squashed. Off to the stove to mend.
kolobok.say.to_stove.0.1: Ow, my crust's cracked! Stove, here I come!
kolobok.say.rest.0.0: Ahh, a warm stove. I'll just lie here and toast a bit.
kolobok.say.rest.0.1: Nothing mends a bun like a hot stove. Ask any grandma.
kolobok.say.rest.2.0: Regenerating on the stove. Do not disturb.
kolobok.say.rest_stale.0.0: I've gone stale... even the stove barely helps. Got any sour cream?
kolobok.say.stove_cold.0.0: The stove's gone cold. Oh well, rolling on.
kolobok.say.rested.0.0: All rested! Ready to run away again.
kolobok.say.rested.0.1: Toasty on both sides. Let's roll!
kolobok.say.woken.0.0: Huh? I wasn't asleep, I was proofing!
kolobok.say.woken.0.1: Aw, my crust was just getting golden...
kolobok.say.phantoms.0.0: You haven't slept in three nights. Hear that flapping?
kolobok.say.phantoms.0.1: Go get some sleep, will you? The phantoms are circling.
kolobok.say.songbook.0.0: Written down! Now you know who I ran away from.
kolobok.say.songbook.0.1: Copied word for word. The tune you'll have to learn by ear.
kolobok.say.songbook_stranger.0.0: A songbook? Be my friend first.
kolobok.say.in_stove.0.0: I'll sit in here a bit. Still warm.
kolobok.say.in_stove.0.1: Knock knock! Nobody home? I'll warm up, then.
kolobok.say.stove_out.0.1: Aw, I'd only just got cosy...
kolobok.say.shoo.0.1: Off you get! This place is reserved for buns.
kolobok.say.alone.0.0: They left... and I was just warming up.
kolobok.say.alone.0.1: Fine. I'll save the rest for later.
kolobok.say.lure.0.1: Leave them alone! Catch me instead!
kolobok.say.caught.0.1: I'm not tasty, honest! It's mostly crust!
kolobok.say.rescued.0.1: Phew! She picked the wrong bun!
kolobok.say.fox_escape.0.0: Wriggled free! Catch me if you can!
kolobok.say.fox_escape.0.1: Got away from the fox too! Sort of.
kolobok.say.fox_lure.0.0: Ooh, a fox! I'll go and say hi.
kolobok.say.dress_ushanka.0.0: Toasty! Now even Father Frost can't scare me.
kolobok.say.dress_ushanka.0.1: Ear flaps! Not that I have ears.
kolobok.say.dress_ushanka.2.0: Winter is coming. I came prepared.
kolobok.say.dress_helmet.0.0: A hero's helmet! Now I just need a sword. And arms.
kolobok.say.dress_helmet.0.1: A knight of the round table. I am the round part.
kolobok.say.dress_crown.0.0: A little big... I'll grow into it.
kolobok.say.dress_crown.0.1: Kneel before the Bun King! Or not. My legs are short too.
kolobok.say.dress_crown.2.0: Heavy is the head that wears the crown. Mine is mostly crust.
kolobok.say.dress_wreath.0.0: Flowers! I'm a garden loaf now.
kolobok.say.dress_wreath.0.1: Spring has sprung, and so have I.
kolobok.say.dress_kokoshnik.0.0: Oh, how pretty! Ready for a round dance.
kolobok.say.dress_kokoshnik.0.1: A kokoshnik! I sing a whole tone higher in it.
kolobok.say.dress_glasses.0.1: Sunglasses: so the sun bakes me evenly.
kolobok.say.dress_lapti.0.0: Bast shoes! I don't roll anymore, I walk. Like a grown-up.
kolobok.say.dress_lapti.0.1: Woven by hand, worn by bun.
kolobok.say.dress_lapti.2.0: Traded my wheels for feet. Upgrade or downgrade?
kolobok.say.dress_same.0.1: Two of the same? I have one head. I am one head.
kolobok.say.dress_stranger.0.0: Thanks, but I don't take presents from strangers. Grandma's rule.
kolobok.say.dress_stranger.0.1: Only my owner gets to dress me. Fairy-tale law.
kolobok.say.undress.0.0: Hey! That was my best outfit!
kolobok.say.undress.0.1: Back to being just a bun.
kolobok.say.outfit_refuse.0.0: That's not my style. Or my head.
kolobok.say.outfit_refuse.0.1: No thanks, I'd look like a scarecrow.
kolobok.say.golova_sneeze.0.0: Turn back, foolish knight! I'm not joking!
kolobok.say.golova_hit.0.1: That's no way to treat a hero's head!
kolobok.say.golova_kladenets.0.0: Oh! There was a sword under me all along! Take it, knight, you earned it.
kolobok.say.golova_kladenets.0.1: The head rolls away, the sword stays behind. Just like in Pushkin. Roughly.
kolobok.say.golova_end.0.0: What a dream... I was a giant head in a helmet. Then again, bread is the staff of life.
kolobok.say.golova_end.0.1: Dozed off. Dreamt I was huge and in a helmet. Woke up small and in a helmet.
kolobok.say.golova_dream.0.0: I'll swallow the rascal whole... Fine, I won't. I'm bread myself.
kolobok.say.golova_dream.0.1: There's no magic sword under me. Don't look... zzz...
kolobok.say.escapade.0.0: Ooh, an audience! Be right back!
kolobok.say.escapade.0.1: I ran away from Grandma... and from you, just for a minute!
kolobok.say.escapade.0.2: Time to sing to them. The public awaits!
kolobok.say.escapade.2.1: Announcing my solo tour of the neighbourhood!
kolobok.say.escapade_alone.0.0: I'll go see what's over there.
kolobok.say.escapade_alone.2.0: Rolling off into the sunset. Back for supper.
kolobok.say.escapade_back.0.1: The concert's over, the artist is on his way.
kolobok.say.escapade_home.0.0: I'm back! Did you miss me?
kolobok.say.escapade_home.0.1: Here I am! They loved me out there.
